meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 为已有的讲话、访谈或播客视频，根据转录内容叠加一组定时出现的图形卡片（标题、字幕条、数据标注、引用、侧面板、画中画等），并渲染成带这些卡片的 MP4，原视频画面保持原样播放。
howto.when: 当你说出“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”等关键词，或要求给已有视频做包装/装饰时触发；纯字幕需求不会触发，不确定时转向 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这个访谈视频加上动态标题和引用卡片，同步到说话内容。
say.note: Claude会生成带卡片的新MP4，原视频保持原样。

say.text: 把我的播客视频包装一下，加数据标注和侧面板。
say.note: 会先分析转录，再按内容设计卡片。

say.text: 为这段讲话视频设计 lower-thirds 和画中画，输出 MP4。
say.note: 需要指定视频文件，输出16:9、9:16或4:5画幅。

howto.what_en: Overlays timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) synced to the transcript on an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video, then renders MP4; original clip untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'graphic overlays', 'on-screen graphics', or package/dress-up requests. Plain subtitles don't trigger it; unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add dynamic titles and quote cards to this interview video, synced to the speech.
say_en.note: Renders a new MP4 with cards; original video untouched.

say_en.text: Package my podcast video with data callouts and side panels.
say_en.note: It transcribes first, then designs cards from the content.

say_en.text: Design lower-thirds and picture-in-picture for this talking-head clip, output MP4.
say_en.note: Specify the video file; output at 16:9, 9:16, or 4:5.
